lesson.title: 积化和差与和差化积公式

source.title: Precalculus: A Unit Circle Approach, 4th edition

method.title: 方法
method.body: $\sin u\cos v=\tfrac12[\sin(u+v)+\sin(u-v)]$；$\cos u\sin v=\tfrac12[\sin(u+v)-\sin(u-v)]$。先写角的和差，再按奇偶性化简。

method.title: Method
method.body: $\sin u\cos v=\tfrac12[\sin(u+v)+\sin(u-v)]$; $\cos u\sin v=\tfrac12[\sin(u+v)-\sin(u-v)]$. Calculate angle sums and differences before applying parity.

concepts.title: 和差化积

method.title: 方法
method.body: $\cos u+\cos v=2\cos U\cos V$；$\cos u-\cos v=-2\sin U\sin V$；$\sin u+\sin v=2\sin U\cos V$；$\sin u-\sin v=2\cos U\sin V$。

pitfalls: 余弦差公式有负号；正弦差的半差在正弦中。

en.title: Sum to product

method.title: Method
method.body: $\cos u+\cos v=2\cos U\cos V$; $\cos u-\cos v=-2\sin U\sin V$; $\sin u+\sin v=2\sin U\cos V$; $\sin u-\sin v=2\cos U\sin V$.

pitfalls: The cosine-difference formula has a minus sign; the half-difference in a sine difference belongs inside sine.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先把两个项转成同一种函数，再用和差化积。弧度与度数不能混用。

method.title: Method
method.body: Convert the two terms to the same function before using sum to product. Do not mix radians and degrees.

concepts.title: 恒等式与定义域
concepts.summary: 和差化积可揭示公共因子；原分母不为零是约分的前提。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 逐项应用公式，写出所得因子并约分。分式恒等式只在原式共同定义域上成立。

en.title: Identities and domains
en.summary: Sum to product reveals common factors; cancellation requires the original denominator to be nonzero.

method.title: Method
method.body: Apply formulas term by term, show the factors, then cancel. Quotient identities hold only on the common domain of the original expressions.

concepts.title: 叠加、电话音和拍频

method.title: 方法
method.body: 载波频率为 $(l+h)/2$，有符号的变化振幅因子为 $2\cos[\pi(h-l)t]$，实际包络为其绝对值。相近频率的拍频为 $|h-l|$。

pitfalls: 两个不同频率的和不是单一正弦波；“频率”在此指教材的载波表示。

en.title: Superposition, telephone tones, and beats

method.title: Method
method.body: The carrier frequency is $(l+h)/2$, with signed amplitude factor $2\cos[\pi(h-l)t]$ and envelope its absolute value. For nearby frequencies the beat frequency is $|h-l|$.

pitfalls: A sum of two distinct tones is not a single sinusoid; “frequency” here refers to the textbook’s carrier representation.

questions.prompt: 用积化和差公式写成两个函数的和或差，尽可能化简：$\sin5\theta\cos3\theta$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 选择 $\sin u\cos v=\frac12[\sin(u+v)+\sin(u-v)]$，代入 $u=5 \theta,v=3 \theta$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $\sin5\theta\cos3\theta=\frac12[\sin(8 \theta)+\sin(2 \theta)]$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 用奇偶性和特殊角值化简得 $\frac{\sin{\left(2 \theta \right)}}{2} + \frac{\sin{\left(8 \theta \right)}}{2}$。

en.prompt: Use a product-to-sum formula to rewrite as a sum or difference of two functions; simplify where possible: $\sin5\theta\cos3\theta$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Choose $\sin u\cos v=\frac12[\sin(u+v)+\sin(u-v)]$ and substitute $u=5 \theta,v=3 \theta$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $\sin5\theta\cos3\theta=\frac12[\sin(8 \theta)+\sin(2 \theta)]$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Apply parity and special-angle values to obtain $\frac{\sin{\left(2 \theta \right)}}{2} + \frac{\sin{\left(8 \theta \right)}}{2}$.

en.label: Example 1

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 半和为 $5 \theta$、半差为 $- \theta$；$\sin4\theta-\sin6\theta=2\cos(5 \theta)\sin(- \theta)=- 2 \sin{\left(\theta \right)} \cos{\left(5 \theta \right)}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 半和为 $\frac{\pi}{3}$、半差为 $\frac{\pi}{36}$；$\cos65^\circ+\cos55^\circ=2\cos(\frac{\pi}{3})\cos(\frac{\pi}{36})=\cos{\left(\frac{\pi}{36} \right)}$。

en.prompt: Write as a product and simplify: (a) $\sin4\theta-\sin6\theta$; (b) $\cos65^\circ+\cos55^\circ$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) The half-sum is $5 \theta$ and the half-difference is $- \theta$; $\sin4\theta-\sin6\theta=2\cos(5 \theta)\sin(- \theta)=- 2 \sin{\left(\theta \right)} \cos{\left(5 \theta \right)}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) The half-sum is $\frac{\pi}{3}$ and the half-difference is $\frac{\pi}{36}$; $\cos65^\circ+\cos55^\circ=2\cos(\frac{\pi}{3})\cos(\frac{\pi}{36})=\cos{\left(\frac{\pi}{36} \right)}$.

questions.prompt: 写成两个三角函数的积并尽可能化简：$\sin5\theta+\cos3\theta$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 先用余函数关系化为同种函数；所需角为 $u=- 5 \theta + \frac{\pi}{2},v=3 \theta$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 半和为 $- \theta + \frac{\pi}{4}$，半差为 $- 4 \theta + \frac{\pi}{4}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 代入和差化积公式：$\sin5\theta+\cos3\theta=2\cos(- \theta + \frac{\pi}{4})\cos(- 4 \theta + \frac{\pi}{4})$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 运用奇偶性并计算特殊角，得 $2 \sin{\left(\theta + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)} \sin{\left(4 \theta + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}$；没有除法，故对所有实参数成立。

en.prompt: Write as a product of two trigonometric functions and simplify where possible: $\sin5\theta+\cos3\theta$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: First use a cofunction identity to obtain matching functions with angles $u=- 5 \theta + \frac{\pi}{2},v=3 \theta$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The half-sum is $- \theta + \frac{\pi}{4}$ and the half-difference is $- 4 \theta + \frac{\pi}{4}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Substitute into the sum-to-product formula: $\sin5\theta+\cos3\theta=2\cos(- \theta + \frac{\pi}{4})\cos(- 4 \theta + \frac{\pi}{4})$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Use parity and evaluate special angles to obtain $2 \sin{\left(\theta + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)} \sin{\left(4 \theta + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}$. No division was used, so the result holds for all real parameters.

en.label: Example 4

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 第1步用 $\sin u=\cos(\pi/2-u)$：三个余角分别为 $3\pi/7,2\pi/7,\pi/7$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 第4步用 $2\sin u\cos v=\sin(u+v)+\sin(u-v)$，分子为 $\sin\pi+\sin(\pi/7)$。最后 $\sin\pi=0$，约去非零 $\sin(\pi/7)$ 得 $1/8$。
